title: Cleaning & Pretreating
summary: Integrated within AZZ Precoat Metals’ coil coating process, cleaning and pretreating improve coating adhesion and manufacturing consistency.
body_markdown:
## Engineered surface preparation for long-term coating performance


AZZ Precoat Metals helps ensure premium quality, durability, and long-term performance through advanced coil coating cleaning and coil coating pretreating processes engineered to optimize coating adhesion and product reliability.


Cleaning removes dirt, debris, oils, and contaminants from the metal surface, creating a smooth, uniform substrate that supports a superior bond between the metal and coating system. Specialized pretreatment applications further enhance paint adhesion, corrosion resistance, and long-term field performance.


Proper surface preparation is one of the most critical steps in the coil coating process.


#### Controlled cleaning and pretreatment help improve:


- Coating adhesion
- Corrosion protection
- Product durability
- Surface consistency
- Long-term appearance retention
- Overall coating performance


These processes also support improved formability, allowing customers to create complex shapes and fabricated components without compromising coating integrity or finished product quality. Integrated within AZZ Precoat Metals’ coil coating process, cleaning and pretreating help improve coating adhesion, manufacturing consistency, and downstream fabrication performance across a wide range of coated metal applications.
